cards.title: Hot Reload
items: Admin updates spec / enabled (core jobs cannot be disabled) or calls CronManager.Trigger manually
Redis pub/sub broadcasts cron:reload and every other Pod reloads in handleMessage
Configuration changes take effect within seconds across two Pods

cards.title: Single-node Execution
items: Each run acquires cron:lock:{name} with a default 5min TTL and ticker renewal
wrapCronFunc injects traceID, checks enabled and recovers panics
terminal-cleanup hourly scans 24h · purge Sunday 04:00 · think daily 00:00
hit-sync and blob-upload-retry every 5min · oauth-maintenance every 10min refreshes and probes quota

cards.title: Observability & Boundaries
items: Every run writes CronCallAudit: status · duration · trigger source
Admin shows execution history and manual reruns; a manual run without the lock is skipped and not audited
Session prefix merges are not Cron jobs; they run after every storage transaction commits
